newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Spotless Services sets bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Spotless Services sets bonus issue.

text.p: Catering and building services group Spotless Services said on Friday it will make a bonus issue of shares in the ratio of 29 new shares for every 30 existing shares.
The bonus shares will participate fully in all rights attaching to fully paid ordinary shares including any dividend for the half year to December 31, 1996.

Directors said they expect present sales and profit trends to result in satisfactory progress in the 1996/97 year and on that basis they expected the normal dividend payout ratio policy to be maintained.
Spotless Services is about 69 percent owned by Spotless Group Ltd.
Spotless Services shares closed three cents lower at A$2.42 on turnover of 6,850 shares.
